com.esignal.jstandard.event

Class MarketDepthEvent

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.EventObject
      • com.esignal.jstandard.event.StatusEvent
        • com.esignal.jstandard.event.SymbolEvent
          • com.esignal.jstandard.event.MarketDepthEvent
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TurnAroundAware, java.io.Serializable

    public class MarketDepthEvent
extends SymbolEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the MarketDepthEvent related data.

    It also contains the List<MarketDepth> object with at least one marketdepth value on it. Added and Deleted event are just for the status purposes, they will not contain MarketDepth List. Only Update event will contain list of MarketDepth objects, which will contain appropriate information depending on the MarketDepth.Type

    Since:
    01-001-0008
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
    See Also:
    MarketDepthListener, Serialized Form
